name: Quinoa Tofu Power Bowl
ingredients: Dressing: 1 tbsp soy sauce, juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp rice vinegar
steps: Sear the tofu in the oil in a non-stick pan for 8 minutes until golden on all sides.
Steam the broccoli and edamame for 4 minutes.
Divide the quinoa between two bowls and arrange the tofu, broccoli, edamame, carrot and avocado on top.
note: Over 25 g protein per bowl, with fibre from the vegetables and healthy fats from avocado.

inspirationReferences.title: Buddha bowl
inspirationReferences.note: Background on the dish and its traditional preparation. Our recipe is an independent, plant-forward adaptation.
